idea-plugin.name: Treadmill Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
Walking pad and treadmill desk tracker: time, distance, steps, and calories for every walk while you code.

Treadmill Buddy is a workout timer, step counter, and calorie tracker for an under-desk treadmill or a walking pad under your standing desk. It runs in every JetBrains IDE, with a large digital clock in its tool window, a status bar widget, and a floating clock that can stay on top.

Four workout modes

  • Marathon: an open-ended stopwatch that counts up.
  • Calorie burn: counts down the time needed to burn a calorie target.
  • KG burn: counts down the time needed to burn a target body mass, in kg or lb.
  • Interval walk: Pomodoro-style walking and break blocks, such as 25 and 5 minutes, with a chime at each switch.

Fitness and health tracking

  • Daily and weekly goals for steps, distance, or calories, with progress bars.
  • Today, last-7-days, and all-time totals, a 14-day distance chart, a six-month activity heatmap, and a walking streak with configurable rest days.
  • Personal records for the longest session and the best day's distance and steps.
  • Optional move reminders after a set time at the keyboard without walking.
  • Steps and calories are estimated from your speed, height, and weight.

Made for walking while you code

  • Auto-pause when the keyboard and mouse go idle, and resume as soon as you type again.
  • Metric or imperial units, speed presets, and four calorie algorithms, including an incline-aware treadmill model.
  • One session history shared by all your JetBrains IDEs, with CSV and JSON import and export, and TCX export for fitness apps.

Open source under the Apache License 2.0. Source code and issue tracker: GitHub.
